(2) It shall corne into force after six months from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette 2 Compulsory use of Standard Mark.- The goods or articles specified in column ( 1) of the Table shall conform to the corresponding Indian Standard mentioned in column (2) of the said Table and shall bear the Standard Mark under a licence from the Bureau as per Scheme I of Schedule-I I of the Bureau of Indian Standard (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018 : Provided that nothing in this Order shall apply to goods or articles meant for export. 3.
